name: – Dainius Žalimas – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on monitoring the application of European Union law in 2023, 2024 and 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the European Commission checks that countries apply EU law. It criticises the Commission for skipping its 2024 yearly report on this, a practice kept since 1983. It asks the Commission to be more open about why it starts legal cases against countries, to act faster when countries ignore EU court rulings, and to treat citizens' petitions as early warnings of problems. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to report yearly again and explain its enforcement choices.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, EU countries that break EU law, and citizens who send petitions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission; the Commission decides whether to act on it.
